However, the test failed due to an unhandled DeprecationWarning related to the use of ABCs from 'collections'. The error message suggests that using or importing ABCs from 'collections' instead of from 'collections.abc' is deprecated since Python 3.3 and will stop working in Python 3.9. from collections.abc import Mapping, Iterable
